arabic:
يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ (ثَلَاثاً). 
 يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى (ثَلَاثاً). 
 لَا يُحَدِّثُ بِهَا أَحَداً. 
 يَتَحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ. 
 يَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ.
transliteration:
Yanfuthu 'an yasaarihi (thalathan).
Yasta'eethu billaahi minash-shaytaani, wa min sharri maa ra'aa (thalathan).
Laa yuhaddithu bihaa ahadan.
Yatahawwalu 'an janbihil-lathee kaana 'alayh.
Yaqoomu yusallee in araada thaalik.
translation:
Spits to his left three times.
Seeks refuge in Allah from the devil and from the evil of what he has seen (three times).
Does not speak about it to anyone.
Turns over on his other side.
Gets up and prays if he desires to do so.
